reproduction_boundary: Owned prepared AWS host required. This is an incremental experiment entrypoint, not a clean-host bootstrap. Dataset and frozen engine come from the prior evidence index; ownership, oracle and completed-phase receipts must be present.
measurement_policy: Two sequential actions per query in each fresh application, no cache flush. Per-query best-of-two suite sums are measured in one actual combined run, not stitched from different candidates.
validation_boundary: Full-scale results match the retained GPU references. Separate CPU adversarial fixtures check schema, decimal/null/duplicate/empty semantics and detect deliberate mutations; no independent full-SF10K CPU run is claimed.
causal_boundary: Q8 changes join order, broadcast placement and supplier payload together. Q9 also changes the join order. Q21 has an additional identical-SQL wide-state control around ABBA; compare it separately from the original optimizer-produced plan.

raw_archive.transfer: Eight immutable SSH ranges, verified full SHA-256

retention: Retain AWS instance until explicit user release
